ask_mic_tap.so: 🎤 Taabo Hadal kadibna hadal — ama hoos ku qor
ask_mic_tap.en: 🎤 Tap Speak, then talk — or type below

ask_err_perm.so: Oggolaanshaha makarafoonka waa dansan yahay — taabo 🔒 ee baarka cinwaanka → oggolow makarafoonka
ask_err_perm.en: Mic permission is off — tap 🔒 in the address bar → allow microphone

ask_err_mic.so: Makarafoonka lama isticmaali karo — fadlan qor
ask_err_mic.en: Can't use the microphone — please type instead

ask_err_nospeech.so: Cod lama maqlin — taabo Mar kale hadal
ask_err_nospeech.en: No voice heard — tap Speak again

ask_err_other.so: Gelinta codka way fashilantay ({code}) — fadlan qor
ask_err_other.en: Voice input failed ({code}) — please type instead
